scenes.phrase: Corgis are on every small dog list in Singapore.
scenes.visual: Corgi sitting alert in a bright HDB corridor

scenes.phrase: You cannot keep one in a flat.
Size is not the test here.
scenes.visual: Maltipoo and Bichon stretched on cool tiles

scenes.phrase: HDB works off a list of sixty-two approved breeds.
Then two things decide it. The heat, and the coat.
scenes.visual: Pug resting in shade beside a water bowl

scenes.phrase: Flat-faced breeds cool through a shortened airway.
scenes.visual: same shade line, hot pavement beyond

scenes.phrase: Curly coats need a groom every six to eight weeks.
The easy ones are the Maltipoo, Cavapoo and Bichon.
scenes.visual: Maltipoo settled on a sofa with its owner

scenes.phrase: Check the list before you fall in love with a breed.
scenes.visual: same sofa, hold on the dog looking to camera
